hypothesis: Replacing BatchNorm with batch-statistics-independent GroupNorm may reduce small-batch and subject-composition sensitivity without changing capacity.
folds: fixed 5 outer contexts x 3 inner validation folds
stop_rule: Retain only after seeds 42/43/44 if mean BA improves by at least 0.01, or is within 0.005 with lower variance and coherent AUROC/F1/calibration gains; at least 9 of 15 seed-averaged matched folds must improve.
